item.title: [+1] ‘Finishing line’: Jaishankar says India and US resolved bulk of trade deal issues, pact could be sealed soon
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 39 reports from Business Standard, The Economic Times, The Indian Express and 31 more. Related: “India-US trade deal nearing finish line, may be sealed soon: Jaishankar”. Ongoing: also reported on 4 of the previous 7 days (first 8 Nov).

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] US trade deal talks near finishing line: EAM
item.description:
